remarks: Freshly painted, this charming 3-bedroom home offers spacious, sun-filled rooms and an inviting layout. The eat-in kitchen opens seamlessly to a deck and private backyard-perfect for everyday living and entertaining. A finished lower-level rec room and office provide even more space for work, play, and relaxation. Ideally located close to downtown New Canaan, top-rated schools, and the train, this home combines comfort, convenience, and style. Not to be missed!
